u0: The box is currently in hand, or any earlier fall has already been recovered, so no outstanding obligation to pick the box up is pending. The objective now is to reach the exit while still carrying the box. If the box slips from the hands before reaching the exit, the agent must pick it up again before finishing.
u1: The box has just slipped out of the agent's hands and has not yet been picked up again, leaving an unmet obligation to recover it. The agent must pick the box up to clear this debt; doing so returns it to normal progress toward the exit. Reaching the exit with empty hands here would leave the requirement violated, while arriving at the exit carrying the box completes the task.
u2: The agent has reached the exit while holding the box, so the requirement to keep the box in hand at the exit and to recover any fall is satisfied and the task is complete.
u3: The agent has reached the exit but is not holding the box, so the requirement to bring the box to the exit has been violated and successful completion is no longer possible.
